_comment: Portals for parallel runs (scripts/parallel.mjs). source = the portal whose data the others are seeded from. Per portal: env overrides; only/skip = regexes on spec paths that portal may take. Defaults for a portal p: ZP_PORTAL=p, ZP_ADMIN_STATE=auth/p/admin.json, ZP_AUTH_DIR=auth/p, ZP_REPORTS_DIR=reports/p, ZP_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/p; project ids come from reports/p/portal-settings.json (written by the seed).
